BMI_Clinical_Note: BMI ≥30 — Indian Obese Class II. High metabolic syndrome risk. Structured weight management post-treatment.
Waist_Risk_Indian: Central Obesity (≥80 cm — Indian Women Threshold)
Bone_Density_Concern: LOW-MODERATE — Routine monitoring. Adequate dietary calcium (dairy/ragi/sesame) + exercise.
Nutrition_Impact_Symptoms: Anorexia/Poor Appetite; Diarrhea; Fatigue; Joint Pain / Arthralgia (AI-related); Lymphedema; Mood Changes; Neutropenia-related (risk); Weight Loss
Vitamin_D_IU_per_day: 400 IU/day (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA) — sunlight 15–20 min/day also essential
Calcium_mg_per_day: 600 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA) — dietary calcium from dairy/ragi/sesame preferred
Zinc_mg_per_day: 10 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — important for immune function + wound healing
Dietary_Fibre_g_per_day: 40 g/day (ICMR-NIN 2020); reduce to 25 g if diarrhoea/mucositis
Omega3_Recommendation: Dietary omega-3: mustard oil cooking + flaxseed + walnuts + fatty fish (if non-veg) 2x/week
Protein_Source_Note: Vegetarian protein: dal+rice combo (complete AA), paneer, curd, soya, moong, rajma, chickpeas, tofu, amaranth
Soy_Food_Guidance: Whole soy foods (tofu/soya/edamame): 1–2 servings/day SAFE for ER+ Indian BC survivors [evidence reassuring]
Alcohol_Guidance: ZERO alcohol — carcinogen; increases BC recurrence risk [ESPEN C5-2]
ICMR_NIN_2020_Reference: ICMR-NIN Nutrient Requirements & RDA for Indians (2020 revision)
Nutrition_Route_ESPEN: Individualized dietary counselling + ONS → EN if goals not met [ESPEN B3-1]
Supplement_Recommendation: ONS 1–2x/day: Pentasure HP / Ensure Plus / Fresubin Energy / Disprolene (Indian brands preferred); Calcium 600 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA) + Vitamin D 400 IU/day + 15–20 min daily sunlight; Vitamin B12 1–2 mcg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) or 500 mcg/week cyanocobalamin — B12 deficiency common in Indian vegetarians; Algae-based DHA 200–500 mg/day (omega-3 for vegetarian Indian BC patients); Iron 19–29 mg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020) — monitor Hb; IV iron if <8 g/dL on chemo; Folate 220–400 mcg/day (ICMR-NIN 2020; higher during chemo); Ground flaxseed 1–2 tbsp/day (lignans — phytoestrogen modulation; beneficial ER+ Indian BC survivors); Megestrol Acetate / short-term Corticosteroid — physician-prescribed [ESPEN B5-1/B5-2] (note DVT risk with megestrol in Indian patients); Multivitamin/mineral at RDA dose ONLY (ICMR-NIN 2020). NOT high-dose. Avoid selenium, Vit E, Vit C megadoses during chemo.
Exercise_Plan_ESPEN_India: Aerobic: Brisk walk 45 min/day OR 150–300 min/week (cycling, swimming, Zumba, yoga) [ESPEN B4-1/C5-1]; Resistance: 2–3x/week, 8–12 reps, major muscle groups; can use resistance bands/body weight at home [ESPEN B4-2]; Yoga: 3–5x/week (Suryanamaskar, Pranayama, Shavasana) — evidence for fatigue reduction + cortisol in Indian BC survivors; LYMPHEDEMA: Progressive resistance IS SAFE — use compression garment; start with light weights, increase gradually; BONE/JOINT PAIN: Low-impact only (swimming, yoga, walking); NO high-impact/contact; physio referral; warm mustard oil massage for joints; TARGET: 150–300 min/week moderate activity — reduces Indian BC recurrence risk and improves overall survival
ESPEN_Guidelines_India: 📋 SCREENING [B1-1]: Regular nutritional assessment from diagnosis. Indian BC patients — ICMR/WHO Asian BMI cut-offs apply (Normal: 18.5–22.9; Overweight: ≥23; Obese: ≥25). [North India (UP/Delhi/Punjab/Haryana)] | 📋 ASSESSMENT [B1-2]: PG-SGA score elevated → quantitative assessment: 24-hr dietary recall, muscle mass (BIA/DEXA/mid-arm circumference), grip strength, CRP/albumin, NIS. | ⚡ ENERGY [B2-1]: 25–30 kcal/kg/day (ESPEN). Indian context: average Indian BC woman body weight 55–65 kg. Total: 1400–2000 kcal/day depending on stage and activity. | 🥩 PROTEIN [B2-2]: >1 g/kg/day (ESPEN); ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA: 0.83 g/kg/day (healthy); BC treatment: 1.0–1.5 g/kg/day. Vegetarian patients: dal+rice+dairy combination essential for complete amino acid profile. | 💊 MICRONUTRIENTS [B2-4 + ICMR-NIN 2020]: Vitamin D (endemic deficiency in India — 400–1000 IU/day), Calcium (600–1200 mg/day from ragi/dairy/sesame), Iron (19–29 mg/day), Folate (220–400 mcg/day). AVOID high-dose antioxidants during chemo. | ⚠ INDIAN OBESITY [Obese Class II]: Indian BMI ≥25 = Obese. Metabolic syndrome highly prevalent. Obesity is independent risk factor for BC recurrence and mortality in Indian women. Weight management essential post-treatment. | 🥗 NUTRITION [B3-1]: Active nutritional counselling + ONS if enriched Indian diet insufficient. | ⚠ INTERVENTION [B3-2]: No energy restriction during treatment. No unproven diets — ketogenic, prolonged fasting, 'cancer-curing' diets widely promoted on Indian social media are NOT evidence-based. | 💊 TAMOXIFEN: AVOID grapefruit/kinnow. ZERO alcohol. Endometrial monitoring. Fibre-rich Indian diet may improve efficacy. Flaxseed safe. | 💊 APPETITE [B5-1/B5-2]: Short-term corticosteroids or megestrol acetate (physician-prescribed). Note: megestrol — DVT risk; monitor in Indian patients with higher thrombosis predisposition. | 🏋 EXERCISE [B4-1/B4-2]: Aerobic + resistance training recommended. Yoga as adjunct for Indian patients (evidence for fatigue, QoL, cortisol reduction). Lymphedema: progressive resistance IS SAFE. | ❌ BEWARE: High-dose supplement marketing targeting Indian cancer patients (social media/WhatsApp) — vitamin megadoses, 'cancer-curing' supplements, unproven herbal products — not recommended without oncologist approval [ESPEN B2-4].
Diet_Chart_Indian_Meal_Plan: 🌅 Breakfast: Multigrain idli (3, ragi+rice+urad) + sambar + tomato chutney + 1 seasonal fruit + green tea | Fermented = probiotic benefit || 🕙 Mid-Morning: Mixed dry fruits (2 dates + 2 figs + 5 almonds + 5 cashews) + 1 glass warm turmeric milk | Anti-inflammatory || 🍽 Lunch: 1 cup brown rice + sambhar (lentil+drumstick — calcium + iron) + 2 vegetable sides (beans + methi/fenugreek) + buttermilk || 🕓 Snack: Banana + moong dal khichdi (plain, no spice) + ORS solution 200ml; AVOID: raw vegetables, high fibre, dairy if intolerant, oily/spicy foods; kairi (raw mango) panna without spice can help electrolytes || 🌙 Dinner: 2 bajra/jowar roti + arhar dal + lauki (bottle gourd) sabzi + dahi | Bajra: magnesium + phosphorus; lauki: easily digestible || 🌛 Bedtime: Chamomile or ashwagandha tea + 5 soaked almonds | Sleep quality + anti-anxiety || ✅ ANOREXIA: 6–8 small Indian meals/day; eat when hunger is best (usually morning); fortify ALL foods: add ghee/coconut oil/peanut butter/milk powder/extra dal/curd; rasam can stimulate appetite; physician may advise megestrol for advanced disease. || ✅ JOINT PAIN (AI-related): Anti-inflammatory foods: haldi (curcumin), adrak (ginger), omega-3 (fish/flaxseed/walnuts), vitamin D. Warm mustard oil massage for joints. Exercise helps reduce AI-related arthralgia. || ✅ LYMPHEDEMA: Maintain healthy weight — obesity worsens lymphedema. Adequate protein for tissue health. Avoid very salty foods (sodium). Compression garment during exercise. Progressive resistance exercise IS SAFE. || 🍷 ALCOHOL: ZERO — complete avoidance mandatory [ESPEN C5-2]. Alcohol is WHO Group 1 carcinogen, increases BC recurrence risk even at low doses. || Regional: Emphasise whole wheat chapati, bajra/jowar roti, dal, seasonal sabzi; reduce heavy ghee, cream, paneer excess; increase green leafy vegetables. || 💰 Middle SES: Balanced home-cooking. Weekly fish/egg 2–3x. Millet rotation. Seasonal produce. Avoid processed/packaged foods marketed as 'healthy'. || ⚠ OBESITY (Obese Class II, Indian cut-off ≥25): Obesity significantly increases BC recurrence risk in Indian women. Post-treatment gradual weight loss (0.5 kg/week max). No energy restriction during active treatment. Mediterranean-Indian hybrid diet: dal-sabzi-millet base + minimal ghee/oil. Walk 45 min/day. || 💊 TAMOXIFEN: AVOID grapefruit, kinnow (citrus that inhibits CYP3A4). ZERO alcohol. High-fibre Indian diet (dal-roti-vegetable) improves tamoxifen efficacy. Flaxseed (1–2 tbsp/day) safe and potentially beneficial. || 🌱 VEGETARIAN BC PATIENT: Complete protein strategy — dal+rice/roti at same meal (complementary AA), include rajma/chana/lentils daily, paneer/tofu/soya 1–2x/day, dahi 1–2 cups/day, sprouted legumes. B12 supplement if vegan. Omega-3: flaxseed + walnuts + algae-based DHA supplement. || ❌ STRICTLY AVOID [ALL INDIAN BC PATIENTS]: Alcohol, tobacco (paan/gutka), vanaspati/dalda (trans fats), excess ghee in obese patients, maida/refined flour products, packaged namkeen/biscuits, sugar-sweetened drinks (even fruit juice), raw/undercooked meat/eggs during chemo. || 🐟 OMEGA-3 FOR VEGETARIANS: Ground flaxseed (1–2 tbsp/day) + walnuts (5–7/day) + mustard oil for cooking + algae-based DHA supplement (250–500 mg/day) — essential since no fish intake. || 🏃 YOGA + EXERCISE [ESPEN B4-1/B4-2]: Brisk walk 45 min/day + yoga (reduces cortisol/fatigue, improves QoL in Indian BC survivors) + resistance 2–3x/week. Reduces BC recurrence risk significantly.
